name: Polynomial Factorization Obfuscation
description: Replaced the transparent linear inequality threshold with a non-linear polynomial identity $C = X$, where $C$ and $X$ are symmetric cross-terms. This identity algebraically factors to $(s_1 - q_1)(s_2 - q_2) = 0$, perfectly encoding the boolean OR gate of a 2-SAT clause. Models that pattern-match linear thresholds to logic gates will fail to recognize the underlying 2-SAT structure without performing explicit algebraic factorization or full truth-table evaluation.
